name.ja: ＨＧ 1/144 高機動型ザク 地上用 (エグバ機)
name.en: HG 1/144 High Mobility Type Zaku Ground Use (Egba Machine)

description.ja: “褐色のサザンクロス隊”
description.en: “Brown Southern Cross Squad”

description.ja: 高 機 動 型 ザ ク 地 上 用、 出 撃 ―
description.en: High mobility type Zaku ground use, sortie -

description.ja: 映画『機動戦士ガンダム ククルス・ドアンの島』より、“褐色のサザンクロス隊”隊長エグバ・アトラーが搭乗する
description.en: From the movie "Mobile Suit Gundam Cucurrus Doan's Island ", Egba Atla, the leader of the " Brown Southern Cross", will be on board.

description.ja: 高機動型ザク 地上用がＨＧシリーズに登場。陸戦に特化した機体形状と武装類を新規造形で立体化。
description.en: High mobility type Zaku ground version now available in the HG series. The aircraft shape and weapons specialized for land battles are three-dimensionalized with new modeling.

description.ja: 特徴的な迷彩模様のカラーリングは成形色と水転写式デカールで再現。ジオン公国軍サザンクロス隊の部隊章やコーションマーク等を収録。
description.en: The characteristic camouflage pattern coloring is reproduced with molded colors and water transfer decals. Contains unit insignia and caution marks of the Zeon Principality Army Southern Cross Corps.

description.ja: ●　高機動型ザク 地上用の機体形状を新規造形を交え徹底再現！
description.en: ●High Mobility Type Zaku Thoroughly reproduces the ground aircraft shape with new modeling!

description.ja: 外装の９割以上を新規造形。機体各所のディテールを精密に立体化。
description.en: More than 90% of the exterior is new. Precisely three-dimensional details of various parts of the aircraft.

description.ja: 頭部ブレードアンテナやシールドに加えホバー走行を可能にする腰部・脚部形状まで精密に再現。
description.en: In addition to the blade antenna on the head and the seal, the shape of the waist and legs that enable hovering are precisely reproduced.

description.ja: ●　膝部可動ギミック搭載
description.en: ● Equipped with a movable knee gimmick

description.ja: 脚部関節には新規引き出しギミックを搭載。膝曲げ時の可動域が大幅に向上。
description.en: The leg joints are equipped with a new drawer gimmick. The range of motion when bending the knee is greatly improved.

description.ja: ●　迷彩模様を成形色と水転写式デカールで再現
description.en: ● Reproduce the camouflage pattern with molded colors and water transfer decals

description.ja: エグバ機の迷彩パターンを成形色と水転写式デカールで再現。塗装なしで印象的な迷彩模様を再現可能。
description.en: The camouflage pattern of the Egba machine is reproduced with molded colors and water transfer decals. Impressive camouflage patterns can be reproduced without painting.

description.ja: ジオン公国軍サザンクロス隊の部隊章やコーションマーク等を収録。
description.en: Contains unit insignia and caution marks of the Zeon Principality Army Southern Cross Corps.

description.ja: ●　近接戦闘に特化した武装類を新規パーツで再現
description.en: ● Reproduce weapons specialized for close combat with new parts

description.ja: G型・改良版ドラムマガジン式MS用マシンガン（銃剣付き）
description.en: G type/improved drum magazine type MS machine gun (with bayonet)

description.ja: 着脱可能な銃剣付きの射撃武装を新規立体化。サブグリップは可動し様々なポージングに対応。
description.en: A new three-dimensional shooting weapon with a detachable bayonet. The sub-grip is movable and supports various poses.

description.ja: 銃剣は腰部にマウント可能。
description.en: The bayonet can be mounted on the waist.

description.ja: ヒート・剣
description.en: heat sword

description.ja: 新規パーツを交え、白兵戦用の実体剣を再現。使用（発熱）時、収納時を差替え式で演出可能。
description.en: Reproduces a physical sword for hand-to-hand combat with new parts. Can be used interchangeably for when in use (generating heat) and when stored.

description.ja: 【使用時】イエローのエフェクトが付属。特徴的な基部の展開も差替え式で再現。
description.en: [When used] Comes with a yellow effect. The characteristic base development is also reproduced with interchangeable parts.

description.ja: 【収納時】ジョイントパーツを使用することでランドセルに収納できる。
description.en: [When stored] Can be stored in a school bag by using joint parts.

description.ja: ●　アクションベース用ジョイントパーツやポージングの幅を広げる左平手パーツが付属。
description.en: ● Comes with joint parts for action base and left palm part to expand the range of poses.

description.ja: 付属武装：G型・改良版ドラムマガジン式 MS用マシンガン（銃剣付き） / ヒート・剣
description.en: Attached weapons: G type improved drum magazine type MS machine gun (with bayonet) / heat sword
